--- a/full/inventory.av
+++ b/full/inventory.av
@@ -2,7 +2,8 @@
     intent =
         "Multi-warehouse inventory with per-SKU stock levels, reservations, and reorder policy."
         "Separates available stock from reserved stock so that pending orders do not silently"
-        "over-commit. Operations return Result to make failure modes explicit."
+        "over-commit. Operations return Result to make failure modes explicit, and batch"
+        "operations commit atomically — all steps succeed, or none are applied."
 
 decision SeparateAvailableAndReserved
     date = "2026-04-16"
@@ -25,6 +26,21 @@
     rejected = ["ExceptionsOrPanics", "SilentNoop"]
     impacts = [receiveShipment, reserveStock, releaseReservation, fulfillReservation, rebalance]
 
+decision AtomicBatchesAsResultChain
+    date = "2026-04-16"
+    reason =
+        "A multi-line order, a truck delivery for many SKUs, or a fleet-wide rebalance must"
+        "either apply every operation or leave the inventory untouched. Because Inventory is"
+        "immutable, folding a list of operations through the existing checked single-step"
+        "functions already has that property: each step returns Result<Inventory, String>, and"
+        "a failure simply short-circuits the fold so the intermediate inventory is discarded"
+        "before any caller observes it. There is no separate transaction log, rollback step, or"
+        "two-phase commit — the Result chain is the atomicity mechanism. The batch error embeds"
+        "the zero-based index of the first failing operation so callers can pinpoint the cause."
+    chosen = "FoldOverCheckedSteps"
+    rejected = ["TransactionLogWithRollback", "BestEffortSkipFailures", "MutableStagingBuffer"]
+    impacts = [reserveBatch, receiveShipmentBatch, rebalanceBatch]
+
 record Sku
     id: String
     name: String
@@ -43,21 +59,53 @@
     warehouses: Map<String, Warehouse>
     levels: Map<String, Map<String, StockLevel>>

+
 fn emptyInventory() -> Inventory

-    Inventory(skus = Map.fromList([]), warehouses = Map.fromList([]), levels = Map.fromList([]))

+    Map.len(emptyInventory().levels) => 0
 
 fn registerSku(inv: Inventory, s: Sku) -> Inventory
     ? "Adds or replaces an SKU definition."
     Inventory.update(inv, skus = Map.set(inv.skus, s.id, s))
 
+verify registerSku

+
 fn registerWarehouse(inv: Inventory, w: Warehouse) -> Inventory
     ? "Adds or replaces a warehouse definition."
     Inventory.update(inv, warehouses = Map.set(inv.warehouses, w.id, w))
 
+verify registerWarehouse
+    Map.len(registerWarehouse(emptyInventory(), Warehouse(id = "W1", location = "NYC")).warehouses) => 1
+
 fn zeroLevel() -> StockLevel
     ? "The stock level used for warehouse/sku pairs with no recorded stock yet."

+verify zeroLevel

+    zeroLevel().reserved => 0
 
 fn getLevelFromMap(perSku: Map<String, StockLevel>, skuId: String) -> StockLevel
     ? "Looks up a stock level in the per-sku submap, defaulting to zero."
@@ -65,22 +113,35 @@
         Option.None -> zeroLevel()
         Option.Some(lvl) -> lvl
 
+verify getLevelFromMap
+    getLevelFromMap(Map.fromList([]), "S1") => zeroLevel()
+    getLevelFromMap(Map.fromList([("S1", StockLevel(onHand = 3, reserved = 1))]), "S1") => StockLevel(onHand = 3, reserved = 1)
+
 fn getLevel(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String) -> StockLevel
     ? "Returns the stock level for (warehouse, sku), or zero if none recorded yet."
     match Map.get(inv.levels, warehouseId)
         Option.None -> zeroLevel()
         Option.Some(perSku) -> getLevelFromMap(perSku, skuId)
 
+verify getLevel
+    getLevel(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1") => zeroLevel()
+
 fn perSkuMap(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String) -> Map<String, StockLevel>
     ? "Returns the existing per-sku submap for a warehouse, or a new empty map."
     match Map.get(inv.levels, warehouseId)
         Option.None -> Map.fromList([])
         Option.Some(m) -> m
 
+verify perSkuMap
+    Map.len(perSkuMap(emptyInventory(), "W1")) => 0
+
 fn setLevel(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, lvl: StockLevel) -> Inventory
     ? "Stores a stock level for (warehouse, sku). Overwrites any previous value."
     updated = Map.set(perSkuMap(inv, warehouseId), skuId, lvl)
     Inventory.update(inv, levels = Map.set(inv.levels, warehouseId, updated))
+
+verify setLevel
+    getLevel(setLevel(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", StockLevel(onHand = 4, reserved = 1)), "W1", "S1") => StockLevel(onHand = 4, reserved = 1)
 
 fn availableStock(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String) -> Int
     ? "Returns units currently available for new reservations: onHand minus reserved."
@@ -96,16 +157,27 @@
         Option.None -> false
         Option.Some(_) -> true
 
+verify knownWarehouse
+    knownWarehouse(emptyInventory(), "W1") => false
+    knownWarehouse(registerWarehouse(emptyInventory(), Warehouse(id = "W1", location = "NYC")), "W1") => true
+
 fn knownSku(inv: Inventory, skuId: String) -> Bool
     ? "Returns true if the sku has been registered."
     match Map.get(inv.skus, skuId)

         Option.Some(_) -> true
 
+verify knownSku

+    knownSku(registerSku(emptyInventory(), Sku(id = "S1", name = "Widget", reorderPoint = 5)), "S1") => true
+
 fn applyReceive(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Inventory
     ? "Unchecked: adds qty to onHand at (warehouse, sku). Assumes inputs are valid."
     lvl = getLevel(inv, warehouseId, skuId)
     setLevel(inv, warehouseId, skuId, StockLevel(onHand = lvl.onHand + qty, reserved = lvl.reserved))
+
+verify applyReceive
+    getLevel(applyReceive(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 7), "W1", "S1") => StockLevel(onHand = 7, reserved = 0)
 
 fn receiveShipmentChecked(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Receives a shipment assuming qty is positive. Checks warehouse and sku are known."
@@ -115,6 +187,9 @@
             false -> Result.Err("Unknown sku: {skuId}")
             true -> Result.Ok(applyReceive(inv, warehouseId, skuId, qty))
 
+verify receiveShipmentChecked
+    receiveShipmentChecked(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 5) => Result.Err("Unknown warehouse: W1")
+
 fn receiveShipment(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Adds qty to onHand. Fails on unknown warehouse/sku or non-positive qty."
     match qty <= 0
@@ -130,6 +205,9 @@
     lvl = getLevel(inv, warehouseId, skuId)
     setLevel(inv, warehouseId, skuId, StockLevel(onHand = lvl.onHand, reserved = lvl.reserved + qty))
 
+verify applyReserve
+    getLevel(applyReserve(applyReceive(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 10), "W1", "S1", 3), "W1", "S1") => StockLevel(onHand = 10, reserved = 3)
+
 fn reserveIfAvailable(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Checks that qty is available before reserving."
     lvl = getLevel(inv, warehouseId, skuId)
@@ -137,6 +215,9 @@
     match qty > avail
         true -> Result.Err("Insufficient available stock: need {qty}, have {avail}")
         false -> Result.Ok(applyReserve(inv, warehouseId, skuId, qty))
+
+verify reserveIfAvailable
+    reserveIfAvailable(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 1) => Result.Err("Insufficient available stock: need 1, have 0")
 
 fn reserveStockChecked(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Reserves after warehouse+sku validation. Delegates to reserveIfAvailable."
@@ -146,16 +227,26 @@
             false -> Result.Err("Unknown sku: {skuId}")
             true -> reserveIfAvailable(inv, warehouseId, skuId, qty)
 
+verify reserveStockChecked
+    reserveStockChecked(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 1) => Result.Err("Unknown warehouse: W1")
+
 fn reserveStock(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Reserves qty for an order. Fails if qty would exceed available (onHand - reserved)."
     match qty <= 0
         true -> Result.Err("Reserve qty must be positive")
         false -> reserveStockChecked(inv, warehouseId, skuId, qty)
 
+verify reserveStock
+    reserveStock(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 0) => Result.Err("Reserve qty must be positive")
+    reserveStock(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 1) => Result.Err("Unknown warehouse: W1")
+
 fn applyRelease(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Inventory
     ? "Unchecked: subtracts qty from reserved. Assumes qty <= current reserved."
     lvl = getLevel(inv, warehouseId, skuId)
     setLevel(inv, warehouseId, skuId, StockLevel(onHand = lvl.onHand, reserved = lvl.reserved - qty))
+
+verify applyRelease
+    getLevel(applyRelease(applyReserve(applyReceive(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 5), "W1", "S1", 3), "W1", "S1", 2), "W1", "S1") => StockLevel(onHand = 5, reserved = 1)
 
 fn releaseIfReserved(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Releases qty from reserved, failing if qty exceeds what is currently reserved."
@@ -163,6 +254,9 @@
     match qty > lvl.reserved
         true -> Result.Err("Cannot release more than reserved: requested {qty}, reserved {lvl.reserved}")
         false -> Result.Ok(applyRelease(inv, warehouseId, skuId, qty))
+
+verify releaseIfReserved
+    releaseIfReserved(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 1) => Result.Err("Cannot release more than reserved: requested 1, reserved 0")
 
 fn releaseReservation(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Cancels a previously made reservation. Fails if qty exceeds current reserved."
@@ -170,10 +264,16 @@
         true -> Result.Err("Release qty must be positive")
         false -> releaseIfReserved(inv, warehouseId, skuId, qty)
 
+verify releaseReservation
+    releaseReservation(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 0) => Result.Err("Release qty must be positive")
+
 fn applyFulfill(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Inventory
     ? "Unchecked: removes qty from both onHand and reserved. Assumes qty <= current reserved."
     lvl = getLevel(inv, warehouseId, skuId)
     setLevel(inv, warehouseId, skuId, StockLevel(onHand = lvl.onHand - qty, reserved = lvl.reserved - qty))
+
+verify applyFulfill
+    getLevel(applyFulfill(applyReserve(applyReceive(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 5), "W1", "S1", 3), "W1", "S1", 2), "W1", "S1") => StockLevel(onHand = 3, reserved = 1)
 
 fn fulfillIfReserved(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Ships qty, failing if qty exceeds what is currently reserved at this (warehouse, sku)."
@@ -181,12 +281,18 @@
     match qty > lvl.reserved
         true -> Result.Err("Cannot fulfill more than reserved: requested {qty}, reserved {lvl.reserved}")
         false -> Result.Ok(applyFulfill(inv, warehouseId, skuId, qty))
+
+verify fulfillIfReserved
+    fulfillIfReserved(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 1) => Result.Err("Cannot fulfill more than reserved: requested 1, reserved 0")
 
 fn fulfillReservation(inv: Inventory, warehouseId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Ships qty out: removes it from both reserved and onHand. Fails if qty exceeds reserved."
     match qty <= 0
         true -> Result.Err("Fulfill qty must be positive")
         false -> fulfillIfReserved(inv, warehouseId, skuId, qty)
+
+verify fulfillReservation
+    fulfillReservation(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 0) => Result.Err("Fulfill qty must be positive")
 
 fn applyRebalance(inv: Inventory, fromId: String, toId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Inventory
     ? "Unchecked: moves qty of unreserved stock from 'fromId' to 'toId'. Assumes source has qty available."
@@ -194,6 +300,9 @@
     toLvl = getLevel(inv, toId, skuId)
     withFrom = setLevel(inv, fromId, skuId, StockLevel(onHand = fromLvl.onHand - qty, reserved = fromLvl.reserved))
     setLevel(withFrom, toId, skuId, StockLevel(onHand = toLvl.onHand + qty, reserved = toLvl.reserved))
+
+verify applyRebalance
+    getLevel(applyRebalance(applyReceive(emptyInventory(), "W1", "S1", 10), "W1", "W2", "S1", 4), "W2", "S1") => StockLevel(onHand = 4, reserved = 0)
 
 fn rebalanceIfAvailable(inv: Inventory, fromId: String, toId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Rebalances after checking source has enough available stock."
@@ -202,6 +311,9 @@
     match qty > avail
         true -> Result.Err("Insufficient stock at {fromId}: need {qty}, have {avail}")
         false -> Result.Ok(applyRebalance(inv, fromId, toId, skuId, qty))
+
+verify rebalanceIfAvailable
+    rebalanceIfAvailable(emptyInventory(), "W1", "W2", "S1", 1) => Result.Err("Insufficient stock at W1: need 1, have 0")
 
 fn rebalanceChecked(inv: Inventory, fromId: String, toId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Rebalances after warehouse and sku validation."
@@ -213,33 +325,198 @@
                 false -> Result.Err("Unknown sku: {skuId}")
                 true -> rebalanceIfAvailable(inv, fromId, toId, skuId, qty)
 
+verify rebalanceChecked
+    rebalanceChecked(emptyInventory(), "W1", "W2", "S1", 1) => Result.Err("Unknown warehouse: W1")
+
 fn rebalance(inv: Inventory, fromId: String, toId: String, skuId: String, qty: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
     ? "Transfers qty of unreserved stock from 'fromId' warehouse to 'toId' warehouse."
     match qty <= 0
         true -> Result.Err("Rebalance qty must be positive")
         false -> rebalanceChecked(inv, fromId, toId, skuId, qty)
 
+verify rebalance
+    rebalance(emptyInventory(), "W1", "W2", "S1", 0) => Result.Err("Rebalance qty must be positive")
+
+fn annotateBatchError(opKind: String, index: Int, err: String) -> String
+    ? "Prefixes a batch step error with the operation kind and zero-based index."
+    "{opKind}[{index}]: {err}"
+
+verify annotateBatchError
+    annotateBatchError("reserve", 2, "boom") => "reserve[2]: boom"
+
+fn seededInventory() -> Inventory
+    ? "Fixture used by batch verify blocks: W1 and W2 registered, S1 and S2 registered,"
+      "W1 holds 10 of S1 and 5 of S2, W2 holds 2 of S1 on hand."
+    inv0 = emptyInventory()
+    inv1 = registerWarehouse(inv0, Warehouse(id = "W1", location = "NYC"))
+    inv2 = registerWarehouse(inv1, Warehouse(id = "W2", location = "LA"))
+    inv3 = registerSku(inv2, Sku(id = "S1", name = "Widget", reorderPoint = 3))
+    inv4 = registerSku(inv3, Sku(id = "S2", name = "Gadget", reorderPoint = 1))
+    inv5 = applyReceive(inv4, "W1", "S1", 10)
+    inv6 = applyReceive(inv5, "W1", "S2", 5)
+    applyReceive(inv6, "W2", "S1", 2)
+
+verify seededInventory
+    availableStock(seededInventory(), "W1", "S1") => 10
+    availableStock(seededInventory(), "W1", "S2") => 5
+    availableStock(seededInventory(), "W2", "S1") => 2
+
+fn reserveBatchFrom(inv: Inventory, ops: List<ReserveOp>, index: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
+    ? "Folds reservations starting at 'index'. Returns the updated inventory on full success,"
+      "or the first failure annotated with the offending index."
+    match ops
+        [] -> Result.Ok(inv)
+        [op, ..rest] -> reserveBatchStep(inv, op, rest, index)
+
+fn reserveBatchStep(inv: Inventory, op: ReserveOp, rest: List<ReserveOp>, index: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
+    ? "Applies one reservation and recurses. Short-circuits on first error."
+    match reserveStock(inv, op.warehouseId, op.skuId, op.qty)
+        Result.Err(e) -> Result.Err(annotateBatchError("reserve", index, e))
+        Result.Ok(inv2) -> reserveBatchFrom(inv2, rest, index + 1)
+
+verify reserveBatchFrom
+    reserveBatchFrom(emptyInventory(), [], 0) => Result.Ok(emptyInventory())
+    reserveBatchFrom(emptyInventory(), [ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 1)], 3) => Result.Err("reserve[3]: Unknown warehouse: W1")
+
+verify reserveBatchStep
+    reserveBatchStep(emptyInventory(), ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 1), [], 0) => Result.Err("reserve[0]: Unknown warehouse: W1")
+
+fn reserveBatch(inv: Inventory, ops: List<ReserveOp>) -> Result<Inventory, String>
+    ? "Reserves stock for a list of operations atomically. Either every reservation is applied"
+      "or the returned Err names the first failing step and the original inventory is unchanged."
+    reserveBatchFrom(inv, ops, 0)
+
+fn availableAfterReserveBatch(inv: Inventory, ops: List<ReserveOp>, wh: String, sku: String) -> Int
+    ? "Runs a reserve batch and returns the queried availableStock on success, or a sentinel"
+      "-1 on failure so that verify cases can distinguish commit from rollback outcomes."
+    match reserveBatch(inv, ops)
+        Result.Err(_) -> -1
+        Result.Ok(inv2) -> availableStock(inv2, wh, sku)
+
+verify availableAfterReserveBatch
+    availableAfterReserveBatch(seededInventory(), [], "W1", "S1") => 10
+    availableAfterReserveBatch(seededInventory(), [ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 3), ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S2", qty = 2), ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W2", skuId = "S1", qty = 1)], "W1", "S1") => 7
+    availableAfterReserveBatch(seededInventory(), [ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 3), ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S2", qty = 2), ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W2", skuId = "S1", qty = 999)], "W1", "S1") => -1
+
+verify reserveBatch
+    reserveBatch(emptyInventory(), []) => Result.Ok(emptyInventory())
+    reserveBatch(emptyInventory(), [ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 1)]) => Result.Err("reserve[0]: Unknown warehouse: W1")
+    reserveBatch(seededInventory(), [ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 3), ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S2", qty = 2), ReserveOp(warehouseId = "W2", skuId = "S1", qty = 999)]) => Result.Err("reserve[2]: Insufficient available stock: need 999, have 2")
+
+fn receiveShipmentBatchFrom(inv: Inventory, ops: List<ReceiveOp>, index: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
+    ? "Folds shipment receipts starting at 'index'. Short-circuits on first failure."
+    match ops
+        [] -> Result.Ok(inv)
+        [op, ..rest] -> receiveShipmentBatchStep(inv, op, rest, index)
+
+fn receiveShipmentBatchStep(inv: Inventory, op: ReceiveOp, rest: List<ReceiveOp>, index: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
+    ? "Applies one shipment receipt and recurses. Short-circuits on first error."
+    match receiveShipment(inv, op.warehouseId, op.skuId, op.qty)
+        Result.Err(e) -> Result.Err(annotateBatchError("receive", index, e))
+        Result.Ok(inv2) -> receiveShipmentBatchFrom(inv2, rest, index + 1)
+
+verify receiveShipmentBatchFrom
+    receiveShipmentBatchFrom(emptyInventory(), [], 0) => Result.Ok(emptyInventory())
+    receiveShipmentBatchFrom(emptyInventory(), [ReceiveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 5)], 2) => Result.Err("receive[2]: Unknown warehouse: W1")
+
+verify receiveShipmentBatchStep
+    receiveShipmentBatchStep(emptyInventory(), ReceiveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 5), [], 0) => Result.Err("receive[0]: Unknown warehouse: W1")
+
+fn receiveShipmentBatch(inv: Inventory, ops: List<ReceiveOp>) -> Result<Inventory, String>
+    ? "Receives a truckload of shipments atomically. Either every line is applied or the"
+      "returned Err names the first failing step and inventory is unchanged."
+    receiveShipmentBatchFrom(inv, ops, 0)
+
+fn onHandAfterReceiveBatch(inv: Inventory, ops: List<ReceiveOp>, wh: String, sku: String) -> Int
+    ? "Runs a receive batch and returns onHand on success, -1 on failure."
+    match receiveShipmentBatch(inv, ops)
+        Result.Err(_) -> -1
+        Result.Ok(inv2) -> getLevel(inv2, wh, sku).onHand
+
+verify onHandAfterReceiveBatch
+    onHandAfterReceiveBatch(seededInventory(), [], "W1", "S1") => 10
+    onHandAfterReceiveBatch(seededInventory(), [ReceiveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 4), ReceiveOp(warehouseId = "W2", skuId = "S1", qty = 6)], "W1", "S1") => 14
+    onHandAfterReceiveBatch(seededInventory(), [ReceiveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 4), ReceiveOp(warehouseId = "W2", skuId = "UNKNOWN", qty = 6)], "W1", "S1") => -1
+
+verify receiveShipmentBatch
+    receiveShipmentBatch(emptyInventory(), []) => Result.Ok(emptyInventory())
+    receiveShipmentBatch(emptyInventory(), [ReceiveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 5)]) => Result.Err("receive[0]: Unknown warehouse: W1")
+    receiveShipmentBatch(seededInventory(), [ReceiveOp(warehouseId = "W1", skuId = "S1", qty = 4), ReceiveOp(warehouseId = "W2", skuId = "UNKNOWN", qty = 6)]) => Result.Err("receive[1]: Unknown sku: UNKNOWN")
+
+fn rebalanceBatchFrom(inv: Inventory, ops: List<RebalanceOp>, index: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
+    ? "Folds rebalance moves starting at 'index'. Short-circuits on first failure."
+    match ops
+        [] -> Result.Ok(inv)
+        [op, ..rest] -> rebalanceBatchStep(inv, op, rest, index)
+
+fn rebalanceBatchStep(inv: Inventory, op: RebalanceOp, rest: List<RebalanceOp>, index: Int) -> Result<Inventory, String>
+    ? "Applies one rebalance move and recurses. Short-circuits on first error."
+    match rebalance(inv, op.fromId, op.toId, op.skuId, op.qty)
+        Result.Err(e) -> Result.Err(annotateBatchError("rebalance", index, e))
+        Result.Ok(inv2) -> rebalanceBatchFrom(inv2, rest, index + 1)
+
+verify rebalanceBatchFrom
+    rebalanceBatchFrom(emptyInventory(), [], 0) => Result.Ok(emptyInventory())
+    rebalanceBatchFrom(emptyInventory(), [RebalanceOp(fromId = "W1", toId = "W2", skuId = "S1", qty = 1)], 5) => Result.Err("rebalance[5]: Unknown warehouse: W1")
+
+verify rebalanceBatchStep
+    rebalanceBatchStep(emptyInventory(), RebalanceOp(fromId = "W1", toId = "W2", skuId = "S1", qty = 1), [], 0) => Result.Err("rebalance[0]: Unknown warehouse: W1")
+
+fn rebalanceBatch(inv: Inventory, ops: List<RebalanceOp>) -> Result<Inventory, String>
+    ? "Applies a list of rebalance moves atomically. Either every move is applied or the"
+      "returned Err names the first failing step and inventory is unchanged."
+    rebalanceBatchFrom(inv, ops, 0)
+
+fn onHandAfterRebalanceBatch(inv: Inventory, ops: List<RebalanceOp>, wh: String, sku: String) -> Int
+    ? "Runs a rebalance batch and returns onHand on success, -1 on failure."
+    match rebalanceBatch(inv, ops)
+        Result.Err(_) -> -1
+        Result.Ok(inv2) -> getLevel(inv2, wh, sku).onHand
+
+verify onHandAfterRebalanceBatch

+#
+# A batch is a sequence of operation descriptors. ``apply_batch`` applies them
+# left-to-right on a local copy of the inventory; if any operation raises, the
+# caller's inventory remains untouched (since Inventory is immutable and the
+# working copy is never assigned back) and ``BatchError`` is raised identifying
+# the failing operation's index and payload.

+    warehouse_id: str
+    sku_id: str
+    qty: int

+    warehouse_id: str

+    sku_id: str

+BatchOp = Union[ShipmentOp, ReserveOp, ReleaseOp, FulfillOp, RebalanceOp]
+
+

+    """Raised when an operation inside ``apply_batch`` fails.
+
+    The inventory passed to ``apply_batch`` is left unchanged. ``index`` points at
+    the zero-based position of the failing operation; ``op`` is the descriptor;
+    ``cause`` is the underlying ValueError message.
+    """

+    def __init__(self, index: int, op: BatchOp, cause: BaseException) -> None:
+        self.index = index
+        self.op = op
+        self.cause = cause
